info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Delete Ecommerce Cart Remove-v3-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Removal API allows users to efficiently remove items from their shopping cart. This endpoint is crucial for maintaining an accurate cart state, enabling consumers to manage their selected products effectively. Typical use cases include scenarios where customers wish to discard unwanted items during their shopping experience. By utilizing this API, businesses can streamline the cart management process, ensuring a more user-friendly and dynamic purchase flow.

delete.summary: Remove an item from the shopping cart
delete.description: This operation allows you to remove a specified item from the user's shopping cart. Ensure the item identifier is valid and the cart is accessible.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the item(s) to be removed from the shopping cart. It contains the necessary details for identifying the products to be deleted.

200.description: Successfully removed item from the cart.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for removing an item from the cart.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveResponse_200.title: Cart Removal Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the cart after removal operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the removal in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message providing information about the operation.

audit.description: Information related to the audit of the operation.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveResponse_200.description: The response object returned after successfully removing an item from the cart.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier for the user who created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Details about the audit for the operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request.
